hints.title: Linear Decomposition
hints.text: The range of a subarray is its maximum minus its minimum, so the total sum is sum_max minus sum_min.

hints.title: Contribution Principle
hints.text: Each element contributes its value multiplied by the count of subarrays where it acts as the extreme element.

hints.title: Monotonic Boundaries
hints.text: Use monotonic stacks to find the previous and next strictly dominant elements for each position.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: The sum of subarray ranges equals the sum of subarray maximums minus the sum of subarray minimums.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all N^2 subarrays directly takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Computing contribution counts via monotonic stack runs in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should decompose range into sum of maximums minus sum of minimums.
